title: Off-street parking based on bedroom count
summary: At the April 17, 2026 meeting, the deputy housing director said ADUs with two or more bedrooms would need two or more parking stalls under Bill 47, which changes off-street parking requirements for housing. The department said 40% of ADUs funded by its ʻohana assistance program have two bedrooms. In July 2025, the council substituted a corrected Bill 47 and sent the parking bill to the Lānaʻi, Maui, and Molokaʻi Planning Commissions.

timeline.text: Bill 47 changes off-street parking requirements for housing.
The department said 40% of the ADUs funded by its ʻohana assistance program have two bedrooms.
The deputy housing director said ADUs (accessory dwelling units, small extra homes on a lot) with two or more bedrooms would need two or more parking stalls.
Motion to substitute Bill 47 and file County Communication 25-15: The council swapped in a corrected version of Bill 47.
Resolution 25-152, referring a parking bill to the Lānaʻi, Maui, and Molokaʻi Planning Commissions: The council sent a proposed bill on off-street parking for housing to the planning commissions.
County Communication 25-15, proposed amendment to Bill 47: Members agreed to hold the proposed amendment until Bill 47 was taken up.
